settings.text: We process and scan C-41 and B&W Film daily, delivering scans via Google Drive. In addition, we offer E-6 and ECN-2 Developing services. Our Standard Turnaround time is about 7 Business Days with 1-Day and 3-Day Rushes. E-6 and ECN-2 Processing times vary

settings.heading: How We Do Things
settings.description: A video to explain our film processing works.

settings.heading: What service do I need?
settings.row_content:
• Easy Develop & Scan: The straightforward process of turning your film rolls into pictures with the simplest checkout experience.
  • Pro Develop & Scan: If you’re a photography nerd like us, and want to get a bit more technical with your film. Like, pushing or pulling your film, having any scanner preferences, or shoot different film sizes. Pro Develop and Scan is what you're looking for.
  • Develop Only: if you don't want to deal with the stinky process of developing your film and are one of the lucky few to have a scanner at home. Our Develop Only service is what you need.

settings.heading: What are negatives?
settings.row_content: Contrary to popular belief, negatives are not your bad pictures. They are the actual roll of film after development. Keep them for archival purposes and or troubleshooting camera issues.

settings.heading: What About Physical Prints?
settings.row_content: In order to get physical prints out of your roll of film, we must have the digital files.

settings.heading: How do I know which processing type to select?
settings.row_content: The film canister displays processing type in small font: C-41, Black and White, ECN-2, or E-6.

settings.heading: How do I get my film to you?
settings.row_content:
• If residing in the Tampa Bay Area, feel free to drop off your film at our Tampa location in person or through the drop box located in the back parking lot.
  • When mailing your film, make use of a box or bubble mailer (envelopes should be avoided) and send it to: 1704 N Nebraska Ave Tampa, FL 33602
  • Ensure to include your name and order number with your film.

settings.heading: How do you deliver my photos?
settings.row_content:
We will upload your pictures to Google Drive and provide you with a link via email to an order folder containing your film rolls.

Download your photos in a timely manner as we will remove them from Google Drive after 1 year.

settings.heading: How long will you keep my negatives?
settings.row_content:
You have 30 days to collect your negatives from our store. The clock starts when we email you to say they're ready for pickup, not when you placed the order.

To request mail delivery instead, contact admin@coastalfilmlab.com.

settings.text:
Our premium service is for discerning photographers who want to have the highest quality film scans with the least amount post editing work. Premium is the best option if you are a busy creative who wants to spend less time in front of a computer and more time taking photos.

Discerning premium customers may also book a personalized color consultation appointment to dial in their exact color preferences, so each order you send closely matches your preferred style.
